macro.headline: Iran/oil (weekend): Sat 10 Oct, the IRGC navy said a 'violating' supertanker exploded after hitting mines while leaving Hormuz by an unauthorized route; on Fri it said it hit the LPG carrier NV Sunshine. It warned that action will extend beyond the strait. Earlier Kpler data showed visible Hormuz transits at a 2-month low.
macro.why: Escalation risk for Mon oil open (Fri close WTI $91.66 / Brent $104.54). Higher oil feeds the inflation premium into CPI and FOMC, which pressures long-duration AI names.

macro.headline: China/tariffs/exports: no new US export rule (BIS newest item 2 Oct, per Peter's World 10 Oct). The US-China truce holds; China's rare-earth control suspension ends 10 Nov and the US affiliates-rule suspension ends 9 Nov. China warned it will respond if the 15-party US 'overcapacity' statement (which covers foundational semis) is used against it; no measure announced.
macro.why: No weekend change to chip export rules; the mid-Nov expiry is the next real risk point.
